doc.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The China trip
summary: China was nice to her group, showed them around and gave gifts; heads of state knew they were coming.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: That was nice to us. They took us around and showed us everything and bought us a lot of things to send home for our . . .
Yeah. It was a nice trip.
Did you find that they knew more about you and the guys than the people here in the States?

I don’t know. I should have talked to them. I don’t know if they knew or if I was a surprise or anything. I don’t know. But the heads of state or something knew we were coming. I don’t know about the masses. I don’t know.
